visual_layout: nutrition-facts style spec label in a blue outlined box with the tube overlapping it, cream dripping over the tube top, white background
claim_type: measured spec stats (SPF value, 0% greasy shine, 100% hydration, 80 mins water resistance)
color_palette: white, royal blue, navy; clean, clinical, precise
risk_notes: relies on unsourced numeric specs (SPF 60.82, 'Hydration Level 100%', 'Greasy shine 0%', 'White Cast: Zero'); SPF 60.82 on the label differs from SPF 50+ on the pack
why_it_works: Borrowing the familiar food-label format makes product specs feel factual and scannable. Each line answers a common sunscreen objection (greasy, white cast, sweat-off) in one row.
